subject: EdgePilot temporary quota uplift + staged reconciliation plan
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah@launchpad.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Launchpad Procurement <procurement@launchpad.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary uplift for product launch (EdgePilot)

Karthik,

We hit a last-minute product pivot that will increase token volume for our launch window next week (Mar 15-18). Can Redwood provide a short-term quota uplift for ~72 hours and a clear path for reconciliation after the event? Procurement will need a simple, signed statement of costs and the true-up approach.

Key ask: +3x baseline quota for 72 hours with a blended overrun rate (to avoid an unreasonable one-off invoice). We prefer staged reconciliation vs. immediate invoice.

I've looped in procurement for payment/PO questions. Happy to jump on a short call today.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Head of Platform
Launchpad / EdgePilot

[Attachment: EdgePilot_Launch_SLA_req.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@launchpad.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary uplift for product launch (EdgePilot)

Sarah — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the pivot. We can support an emergency uplift but want to align on economics and reconciliation so procurement has clarity.

High-level proposal (quick):
- 72-hour uplift window: +3x committed baseline QPS/throughput.
- Blended overrun: 50% of the uplift billed at your committed committed rate, 50% at an elevated burst surcharge (we can split by token bands).
- Post-event: 7-day metered true-up with the option to convert some uplift into a temporary prepay credit if you want to lower cash flow volatility.

I've attached a provisional quota matrix and a one-page true-up summary for procurement. Laura — can you confirm the blended bands we discussed? Ben — can you weigh in on any promo/launch credit we can provide?

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: EP-4492_provisional_quota_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary uplift for product launch (EdgePilot)

Karthik / Ben — quick notes on the bands:
- Baseline unit price: $0.012/token (committed band).
- Uplift blended: first 70% of uplift at baseline, remaining 30% at $0.03/token for the surcharge. That produces a single blended effective price of ~ $0.018/token for uplift volume — easier for procurement.
- True-up mechanics: we run a usage report, invoice provisional uplift after the 7-day reconciliation window, and then apply any prepay conversion credits within the next invoice cycle.

I'll attach the draft terms (legal-friendly) for a procurement-ready doc. If procurement needs a PO-first flow we can create a short addendum.

Laura
Sr. Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: proposed-trueup-terms.pdf (pdf)]

Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary uplift for product launch (EdgePilot)

Thanks for the proposal. Two procurement notes before we sign: 
1) We need total not-to-exceed estimate for worst-case uplift so we can route internal approvals. Please provide an upper-bound estimate (72h at 3x).
2) For accounting, we prefer staged reconciliation but require the invoice to include a clear description and the link to the usage report.

We'll need a short form amendment (one page) that we can attach to our PO. Also confirm whether Redwood can accept a Net30 invoice for the true-up (we have a standard Net30 flow).

Procurement
Launchpad Inc.
